text:
[Council File 26-1372; CD 4]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the transfer of Proposition K funds for a new data network to support the security system and building monitoring systems of the Studio City Recreation Center – Gymnasium project located at 12621 Rye Street in Council District Four (CD 4).
Recommendations for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Raman - Blumenfield), SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. APPROVE the transfer of $18,674.56 from Proposition K Fund No. 43K/10, Account No. 10L479 (PRJ - Studio City), to the Information Technology Agency’s (ITA) Fund No. 100/32, Account No. 009350 (Communication Services), for new data network at the Studio City Recreation Center – Gymnasium within CD 4.
From:
Proposition K, Fund No. 43K/10, Account No. 10L479 – (PRJ – Studio City): $18,674.56
To:
ITA, Demand No. DMND0010212, Fund No. 100/32, Account No. 009350 – Communication Services:
$18,674.562.
2. AUTHORIZE the Bureau of Engineering to prepare the Controller’s instructions and to make any corrections, clarifications, or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be orally, electronically, or by any other means.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: A motion to transfer Proposition K funds for a new data network that will support the security and building monitoring systems at the Studio City Recreation Center gymnasium project.
